"482e6d01-f9bf-525e-86f9-c527dca5de7f" :question/id #uuid "482e6d01-f9bf-525e-86f9-c527dca5de7f" :question/problem "Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x-3y=-5 \\ -2x+6y=10\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.

- **I.** The system is consistent dependent
- **II.** The system is consistent independent
- **III.** The system is inconsistent" :question/worked-solution "To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -5 \\ -2 & 6 & 10\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -5 \\ -2 & 6 & 10\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. Here there is one free variable, $y$. Therefore, since there are infinitely many solutions, we conclude that the system is *consistent dependent*.

As a result, only statement I is true." :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["8925e95f-c16a-5da9-bc62-4ffcfe2c9609" "d98057d3-cab1-5021-9e07-c30835639d6d" "Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x+2y=-3 \\ -2x-4y=3\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.

- **I.** The system is consistent independent
- **II.** The system is consistent dependent
- **III.** The system is inconsistent" :question/worked-solution "To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -3 \\ -2 & -4 & 3\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -3 \\ -2 & -4 & 3\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -3\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

The final row corresponds to the equation $0x+0y=-3,$ and this has no solution. Therefore, our system has no solution, and we conclude that the system is inconsistent.

As a result, only statement III is true." :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["cfcb9672-726a-595a-b7dd-19a4952a0aab" "dc3eaf4f-09ba-503b-a672-da707e643826" "Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x-3y-3z=5 \\ 2x-5y-9z=10 \\ 2x-5y-9z=10\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- **I.** The system is consistent dependent
- **II.** The system is inconsistent
- **III.** The system is consistent independent" :question/worked-solution "To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -3 & 5 \\ 2 & -5 & -9 & 10 \\ 2 & -5 & -9 & 10\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -3 & 5 \\ 2 & -5 & -9 & 10 \\ 2 & -5 & -9 & 10\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -3 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 0 \\ 2 & -5 & -9 & 10\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -3 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 0\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{2} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & -3 & -3 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. Here there is one free variable, $z$. Therefore, since there are infinitely many solutions, we conclude that the system is *consistent dependent*.

"Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x+2y-2z=-4 \\ x+3y=-8 \\ x+y-4z=-3\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

- **I.** The system is consistent independent
- **II.** The system is consistent dependent
- **III.** The system is inconsistent" :question/worked-solution "To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & -8 \\ 1 & 1 & -4 & -3\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & -8 \\ 1 & 1 & -4 & -3\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & -4 & -3\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & 1\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(1){R}_{2} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

The final row corresponds to the equation $0x+0y+0z=-3,$ and this has no solution. Therefore, our system has no solution, and we conclude that the system is inconsistent.

"Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x+2y-z=1 \\ 2x+5y=7 \\ -2x-3y+5z=6\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.

- **I.** The system is inconsistent
- **II.** The system is consistent independent
- **III.** The system is consistent dependent" :question/worked-solution "To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & 0 & 7 \\ -2 & -3 & 5 & 6\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & 0 & 7 \\ -2 & -3 & 5 & 6\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 5 \\ -2 & -3 & 5 & 6\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(2){R}_{1} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & 8\end{bmatrix} & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{2} \\ & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

There is a pivot for each variable and no contradictory row. The system has a unique solution, so we conclude that the system is consistent independent.
